verdict.rationale: The developer llms.txt names an official npm package, `@rippling/rippling-sdk`, and tells developers to check the npm registry before pinning a version. It sits on a documented v2 REST API with Bearer-token auth, dated version pinning and cursor pagination. Beyond that one mention, the evidence says nothing about how the SDK is used, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: SDK usage docs and API reference, coverage of IT-specific endpoints in the SDK, SDKs for languages other than JavaScript/TypeScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK.
